prompt: Award-winning luxury fashion campaign photography for Monavi Collection ("Wear Your Story"). Sophisticated 26-year-old Indian female fashion model with natural South Asian elegance, understated dewy makeup, confident calm gaze, graceful posture, wearing premium bespoke Anarkali crafted from rich Georgette, Chanderi Silk, Mulmul with Gota Patti in shades of Deep Maroon, Mustard Ochre, Teal Blue. Intricate tailoring, pristine seam lines, tactile fabric weave, authentic drapery and natural folds. Setting: Warm heritage courtyard with marigold floral decor and carved sandstone pillars. Lighting: Warm golden hour ambient light, rich specular reflections on silks. Camera: Shot on Hasselblad H6D-100c medium format, 85mm f/1.4 lens, shallow depth of field, authentic filmic color rendition. Skin & Anatomy: Natural human skin pores, fine skin texture, anatomically perfect hands and fingers, realistic fabric texture, ultra-high resolution 8k. Composition rule: Model is positioned towards the center-right. The left 40% has smooth cinematic falloff and clean negative space reserved for brand typography. Framing rule: Full-length or three-quarter standing portrait showing the complete ensemble from head to knees and ankles, ensuring BOTH the upper kurta/tunic and lower pajama/churidar/skirt are fully and visibly showcased. Never crop at waist.
